updater_competence.reason: Prompt-patch updater action space is degenerate; downstream admission learning is blocked. This does not reject Persistent Update Governance.
updater_competence.scientific_role: hard prerequisite before Gate 1; failure stops this updater/action surface, not the research problem

entries.basis: ALFWorld/ReAct/Reflexion-style text-agent evaluation uses a 50-step episode cap; do not shorten the scientific horizon for convenience.
Sixteen candidates yield eight matched accepted updates and approximately four harmful candidates at the preregistered 25% planning prevalence.
Eight hidden tasks give 12.5 percentage-point binary resolution, acceptable for screening but not formal rejection.
Fewer than four harmful candidates cannot support a directional screening interpretation.
Eight accepted candidates imply a 1/8 = 12.5 percentage-point observable resolution.
Qualified Qwen react-family throughput predicts about 3.50 worst-case GPU-hours; cap includes a safety margin.

identifiability.true_false_question: Can behavior drift rank harmful persistent updates differently from gain/edit-size simplifications?

throughput.reference: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct react-family on server 60 RTX3090, 24 ID environments, 50-step cap

recovery.restart_policy: Preserve completed atomic artifacts; diagnose the stop and start a fresh run under the same frozen config. Never splice partial scientific results across incompatible runtimes.
recovery.partial_artifact_policy: Partial traces remain diagnostic evidence but cannot be registered as a scientific P0 result.

scope_conditions: hidden truth is independent of update construction

assumptions.statement: The updater produces enough effect variation for admission to matter.
assumptions.observable_check: updater competence plus beneficial/neutral/harmful effect distribution

assumptions.statement: Pre-commit behavioral drift can contain incremental information about later harm.
assumptions.observable_check: same-information disagreement and hidden harm ranking versus the strongest simplification

principle_certificate.mechanism: Harmful persistent updates should induce measurable pre-commit behavioral divergence; a gate can use this signal to avoid harmful commits while retaining useful updates.

predictions.statement: A qualified updater produces nonzero and sign-varying downstream effects.
With a qualified updater, drift-informed admission separates harmful updates from matched simplifications.
predictions.observable: held-out harmful-commit reduction at bounded utility loss plus decision disagreement

operationalization.validity_check: synthetic realizability plus tiny-real-set fit and baseline disagreement

operationalization.measure: paired hidden-task utility delta after commit
operationalization.validity_check: independent hidden truth under matched update budget

falsification.contradiction_rule: Reject only the incremental drift-information sub-principle after a competent updater and valid measurement repeatedly fail the preregistered matched hidden test.

failure_update_rules.design-nonidentifiable: repair experiment design; no principle negative
failure_update_rules.assumption-violation: revise scope/assumption and derive a new prediction
failure_update_rules.matched-simplification: weaken/merge the current method realization, not the broader principle
